newsitem.title: USA: ServiceMaster declares stock split, payout.
newsitem.headline: ServiceMaster declares stock split, payout.

text.p: ServiceMaster LP said Friday its board of directors declared a three-for-two stock split effective June 25 to shareholders of record on June 11.
Any fractional shares will be redeemed in cash, the company said.
The board also authorized a quarterly cash dividend of $0.12 a share on a post-split basis, payable on July 31 to shareholders of record on July 18, ServiceMaster said.
ServiceMaster said it also expects to distribute a $0.12 a share dividend next quarter.

The dividends will result in a total 1997 cash distribution of $0.46667 per share on a post-split basis and $0.70 before the split, slightly higher than the company's previously announced intention to distribute $0.69 a share.
ServiceMaster is a network of service companies with two major segments, ServiceMaster Consumer Services and ServiceMaster Management Services.
